failure_mode_rationale.tension: Matrix cracking and subsequent fiber bridging permit load beyond tensile proportional limit. Ultimate load may coexist with damage and loss of hermeticity.
failure_mode_rationale.compression: Fiber/tow instability, interface sliding, debonding and delamination can govern;2018 paper reports quasi-static bundle buckling and debonding.
failure_mode_rationale.inference: Neither tensile PLS nor tensile UTS nor monolithic ceramic compression replaces missing process/direction-specific CMC compression data.

concerns: Long bonded furnace tubes are not demonstrated structural nodes under the target axial force, bending, contact or vacuum requirements.
Clamps, pins, flanges and tube ends produce local bearing, bending and ovalization; uniaxial compression is not a contact allowable.
CMC fiber termination, hoop reinforcement and through-wall splitting require separate tests.
Joint eccentricity contributes moment N*e; collars, reinforcement and overlap require mass and stiffness accounting.
No target-geometry yield, flaw distribution, proof survival or interchangeability evidence at quantity1046.
Need net-shaped arc demonstration and centerline/ovality/minimum-wall maps, then tube/joint tests and statistical allowables.
